measure_name: Climate resilience standards, regulation and planning
definition: A commitment to establish, strengthen or implement policies, regulations, standards, building or engineering codes, plans, strategies, technical guidelines or governance arrangements that build climate resilience into a sector or an asset class. Counts when the project finances or requires the framework and climate resilience is written into it. Does not count: alignment with an existing national strategy, a standalone study, training activities, or a plan mentioned as context.
note: First cut from Dev's measure template, 2026-10-20; patterns anchored to a climate or energy word where the bare word would match thousands of sentences.
